text:
> **Version:** CE Express v7.2
**1. Objective**
This tutorial will show you how to add new MW links, manage and do predictions.
At the end of the exercise you will be able to:
- Create and import MW equipment.
- Create MW links in the project.
- Do MW Predictions.
**2. Initial data**
Prepared project with:
- Geodata.
- Equipment and [models](#kw:31-models:ce-express-tr-models).
**3. Manage MW equipment**
Navigate to C:\CE_Course\MW_Equipment\Project and run Project.aprx file to open the
prepared project for RL Introduction exercise.
Microwave links involve additional equipment settings compared to point-to-area predictions.
These settings include frequency plans, radio equipment, and parabolic antennas, which are
used for predicting power budget, interference, or availability. In this section, we will cover
how to create and, if necessary, import this data into the project.

Open Antenna Viewer in CE RLP tab, and change antenna type from Sector to Parabolic.
![Image p2](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp002-img1.png)
All parabolic antennas will be displayed.
![Image p3](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp003-img1.png)
Close Antenna Viewer tool. To import a new parabolic antenna, open Import/Export Antenna
Files tool. Parabolic antenna import supports:
- Andrew format:
![Image p3](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp003-img2.png)
- NSMA format:
![Image p4](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp004-img1.png)
Select Parabolic (NSMA Format).
![Image p4](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp004-img2.png)
Click on Select Antenna Model Files
![Image p4](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp004-img3.png)
Browse to C:\CE_Course\RL_Prediction\Equipment\Antennas, select Antenna10GHz.txt file
and press OK button. It will appear in Import/Export Antenna Files dialog.
![Image p4](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp004-img4.png)
Select Check box near the antenna and press Import Antennas button.
![Image p5](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp005-img1.png)
Antenna will be imported successfully. Now choose Andrew format.
![Image p5](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp005-img2.png)
Click on Select Antenna Model Files
![Image p5](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp005-img3.png)
Browse to C:\CE_Course\RL_Prediction\Equipment\Antennas, select a2119.adf antenna
and press OK button to add it.
![Image p5](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp005-img4.png)
Select Check box near the antenna and press Import Antennas button.
Now open Antenna Viewer tool to review these antennas.
![Image p6](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp006-img1.png)
![Image p6](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp006-img2.png)
Close Antenna Viewer and Import tools.

This equipment category encompasses details about radio transceivers utilized in microwave
links. It comprises information on transmitter power, receiver sensitivity, noise figure,
nonlinearity characteristics, and maximum data capacity.
Open [Radios](#kw:710-radios:ce-pro-rlp) tool in CE RLP tab and preview available Radio within default CE workspace.
![Image p7](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp007-img1.png)
It has parameter section, and Modulations section.
![Image p7](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp007-img2.png)
Click on Add button in top right corner of the dialog.
![Image p7](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp007-img3.png)
Define the same parameters as defined below:
- Model: RL Radio
- Manufacture: CE
- Frequency From, MHz: 9500
- Frequency To, MHz: 10500
- Bandwidth, MHz: 10
- MTBF, h: 300000
- MTTR, h: 24
- Bit Rate, kbps: 2048
- Block Size, bits: 2048
- Burst Errors: 1
- Dispersive Fade Margin, dB: 50
- BER 10-3 Threshold, dBm: -76
- BER 10-6 Threshold, dBm: -72
- Noise Figure, dB: 5
- Residual BER: 1E-12
- IIP2, dBm: 30
- IIP3, dBm: 29
- XPIF, dB: 20
- Power, dBm: 20
- Power Low, dBm: 10
- Power High, dBm: 26
- Automatic Transfer Power Control Range, dB: 20
![Image p9](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp009-img1.png)
![Image p9](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp009-img2.png)
Click on Modulations tab, and include these modulations:
![Image p9](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp009-img3.png)
You can do it simply selecting modulation from the list and press + button to add it for the
radio.
Each modulation has its own default parameters.
![Image p10](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp010-img1.png)
Leave default parameters and press Create button. The new radio will be added in the list.
![Image p10](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp010-img2.png)
Click on Import tab.
![Image p10](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp010-img3.png)
Click on Seleted Data File and navigate to C:\CE_Course\MW_Equipment\Equipment\Radio,
select Aur24_1E1.raf and press OK button.
![Image p11](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp011-img1.png)
New radio with the parameters will be added to the dialog. Press Import button to import it
to the database.
![Image p11](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp011-img2.png)
Close Radio tool.

Frequency planning is important for microwave link design, optimizing spectrum use, and
preventing interference. By strategically allocating frequency bands, it enhances efficiency,
complies with regulations, and coordinates with other services. This planning considers
propagation characteristics and facilitates scalability, ensuring optimal performance for
microwave links in various environments and supporting future technology upgrades.
Frequency plans can be imported from a text file, or created manually.

Open Frequency Plans tool in CE RLP tab.
![Image p12](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp012-img1.png)
Click on Add section and define:
- Frequency Plan Name: FP 10MHz 8 Carriers
- Low Frequency, MHz: 9800
- Carrier Spacing, MHz: 50
- Duplex Spacing, MHz: 300
- Carriers: 8
High Frequency, MHz will be filled automatically.
![Image p12](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp012-img2.png)
Press Add Frequency Plan button.
The new frequency plan will appear in the main dialog.
![Image p12](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp012-img3.png)

Click on Import option, and then on Select Data Files.
![Image p13](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp013-img1.png)
Navigate to C:\CE_Course\RL_Prediction\Equipment\FrequencyPlans, select all files and
press OK button.
![Image p13](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp013-img2.png)
Frequency Plans will be added to the preview.
![Image p13](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp013-img3.png)
Press Import button and they will be imported to the database.
![Image p14](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Ftraining-07%2Fp014-img1.png)
Close Frequency Plans dialog.
